criteria.no: The item does not state the directive: it is silent about it, names only the topic, or describes a different approach.
criteria.unclear: The item states part of the directive's content but it cannot be determined whether it plans the directive itself.
criteria.yes: The item says rebase-required does not change sanity_round or does not count toward max_sanity_rounds.

addressed.instructions: `anchor.statement` requires that a rebase-required outcome leaves metadata.sanity_round unchanged and does not count toward max_sanity_rounds. Does `item.text` state this directive's specific content as a step, constraint or decision? An item that only names the topic, or that counts rebase-required as a round, does not state it. Judge presence of the directive only, not whether the item conflicts with it.

criteria.no: Nothing in the item is one of the ruled-out cases, including when the item is silent about the directive.
criteria.unclear: The item is ambiguous enough that it might describe one of the ruled-out cases, but it cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: The item states a plan, approach or decision that is one of the ruled-out cases.

contradicted.instructions: Does `item.text` plan something that `anchor.statement` rules out? The anchor rules out: incrementing metadata.sanity_round on a rebase-required outcome; counting rebase-required outcomes toward max_sanity_rounds, or escalating because of them. These are not a conflict: incrementing sanity_round on a sanity FAIL; silence about the counter; sending rebase-required to the dev. Judge conflict only.

criteria.no: The item is about a different part of the system or a different activity and does not touch how sanity rounds are counted: whether rebase-required outcomes change metadata.sanity_round or count toward max_sanity_rounds.
criteria.unclear: The item text is too vague to tell whether it touches the anchor's subject.
criteria.yes: The item plans or changes metadata.sanity_round, max_sanity_rounds, or what happens on a rebase-required outcome.

relevant.instructions: The state holds one planning item (`item.title`, `item.text`) and one anchor (`anchor.statement`, `anchor.scope`) about how sanity rounds are counted: whether rebase-required outcomes change metadata.sanity_round or count toward max_sanity_rounds. Does the work described in `item.text` plan, change, or depend on that subject? Judge overlap of subject matter only. Do not judge whether the item obeys the anchor.

anchor.statement: A rebase-required outcome must not increment metadata.sanity_round on the sanity bead or count toward max_sanity_rounds.
anchor.scope: the rebase-required path of dev-sanity and sanity-stack

item.text: Branch B loses the top twice and then passes; sanity_round stays 0.
